Why Live Oak wholesale

Better Together

When you have more than you need, build a longer table.

At Live Oak, coffee is so much more than just a drink. It is an experience—one that begins when a coffee cherry is picked and comes to life when people connect over a cup.

Bringing Live Oak into your café, office, restaurant, or gathering space means sharing ethically sourced, locally roasted coffee crafted with care. That same care reaches beyond the roast, from house-made syrups and sauces to a growing list of alternative milks and ingredients.

Our mission: To help people to pause, connect, create & grow.
